start_time = time.time()
n = 17

var_cnt = 1
edge_var = {}

color_var = [[0]*3 for _ in range(n)]

    for c in range(3):
        color_var[v][c] = var_cnt
        var_cnt += 1
total_vars = var_cnt - 1
print('Variables:', total_vars)
# Clauses
clauses = []
def get_edge(u, v):
    return edge_var[(min(u, v), max(u, v))]
# Exactly one color per vertex
for v in range(n):

    for a, b in [(0,1), (0,2), (1,2)]:

# Edge implies different colors
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):

        for k in range(3):
            clauses.append([-e, -color_var[i][k], -color_var[j][k]])
# No C3

    a, b, c = comb
    clauses.append([-get_edge(a,b), -get_edge(b,c), -get_edge(c,a)])
# No C4
for comb in itertools.combinations(range(n), 4):
    a, b, c, d = comb
    clauses.append([-get_edge(a,b), -get_edge(b,c), -get_edge(c,d), -get_edge(d,a)])
    clauses.append([-get_edge(a,b), -get_edge(b,d), -get_edge(d,c), -get_edge(c,a)])
    clauses.append([-get_edge(a,c), -get_edge(c,b), -get_edge(b,d), -get_edge(d,a)])
print('Cycle clauses up to C4:', len(clauses))
# No C5
for comb in itertools.combinations(range(n), 5):
    verts = list(comb)
    start = min(verts)
    others = [v for v in verts if v != start]
    for perm in itertools.permutations(others):
        cycle = [start] + list(perm)
        if cycle[1] > cycle[-1]: continue  # to do only half
        edges = [get_edge(cycle[i], cycle[i+1]) for i in range(4)]
        edges.append(get_edge(cycle[4], start))
        clause = [-e for e in edges]
        clauses.append(clause)
print('Clauses after C5:', len(clauses))
# No C6
for comb in itertools.combinations(range(n), 6):
    verts = list(comb)
    start = min(verts)
    others = [v for v in verts if v != start]
    for perm in itertools.permutations(others):
        cycle = [start] + list(perm)
        if cycle[1] > cycle[-1]: continue
        edges = [get_edge(cycle[i], cycle[i+1]) for i in range(5)]
        edges.append(get_edge(cycle[5], start))
        clause = [-e for e in edges]
        clauses.append(clause)
print('Clauses after C6:', len(clauses))
# At least 26 edges
edge_lits = list(edge_var.values())
card_clauses = CardEnc.atleast(lits=edge_lits, bound=min_edges, encoding=EncType.sequential_counter)
clauses.extend(card_clauses)
print('Total clauses:', len(clauses))

# Solve
solver = Glucose3()
